name: Ashe Hawthorne
source: The protagonist of the story, she is a dual-gendered (duplo) futanari which means she has a penis and a vagina, which is rare in the protagonist's world. This causes trouble for her because duplos have uncontrollably high libidos and get easily aroused, which causes discrimination against them. She keeps the fact that she is one for her safety. She has a twin sister [url=/c135348]Rachel Hawthorne[/url], whom she used to be close with until a certain incident that happened in the past. Her mother is [url=/c135338]Evelyn Hawthorne[/url].
